problem: Hostel-dwelling college students struggle to find affordable, healthy food options near campus and rely on expensive, unhealthy fast food delivery apps.
target_customer: College students living in university hostels and off-campus housing
solution: NutriNest: A hyper-local food discovery and subscription platform connecting students with vetted healthy meal vendors and mess plans.
pain_points: High cost of daily meals on generic food delivery apps
Lack of dietary filters for healthy/home-cooked student meals
Irregular eating habits leading to health issues during exams
assumptions: Students are willing to switch from Swiggy/Zomato for healthy meal subscriptions
Local tiffin/mess providers are eager to list on a student-focused platform
risks: Incumbents (Swiggy/Zomato) can easily introduce student/healthy meal filters
Price sensitivity among college students limiting profit margins
missing_information: Exact pricing tier acceptance among hostel students
Vendor onboarding capacity in pilot university zones
Customer acquisition cost (CAC) for student campus ambassadors

first_question.text: Which specific student sub-segment are you targeting first, and what is their monthly meal budget?
